name: Datashaper Observation
text:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner Cyberse Monsters
Once Per Turn (Quick Effect): You can Target 1 Link Monster your Opponent controls. This card gains ATK Equal to that mosnter's Link rating x200. If this card is sent to the GY, you can shuffle 1 Cyberse monster from your GY into the deck then draw 1 card.
